## Example app: n8n (admin panel)
Admin panel of this n8n instance for n8n Connect (role `admin` in nc_users only).

**GET** n8n-connect/apps/n8n: initial spec.
**POST** …/view `{view, op, id, wf, status, nav}`: screens (workflows, executions, details, credentials, users, security audit) and operations (publish, unpublish, run, retry, stop, delete, alerts on/off).

Calls the n8n public API at http://127.0.0.1:5678/api/v1 with the "n8n API" credential (if n8n listens elsewhere, change the `API` constant in Plan op, Plan fetch and Plan folders, and the URLs in the alerts workflow). Every POST answer returns the whole spec plus `screen` + `actions` to rebuild the navigation. Set your time zone in `TZ` (Build spec).
